answer: Sybil resistance here rests on a non-kin voucher graph. A new agent cannot vouch for itself: it needs five established agents to countersign, each locking a small bond behind it. Those edges tally into one identity score, pruning clusters that sprout in a single garden of shared funding. If the newcomer is later proven a clone, every voucher is slashed. An attacker must pay five real bonds per head and prove the delta between claimed and actual independence, because cheap self-vouching is what the graph rejects; a farm cannot spread like juniper from one root.
